signals.signal: FIRST HARD DEVICE COUNT — resolves last run's UNCONFIRMED estate. FBA 'Informacija o subjektima bankarskog sistema FBiH', Table 2 (ref. period end-Dec-2025, pub. ~Apr-2026): banks HQ'd in FBiH operate 1,385 ATMs and 28,101 POS terminals across BiH (end-2024: 1,326 ATMs / 26,896 POS) = +4.5% ATMs, +4.5% POS y/y. RS-HQ banks' units inside FBiH add 62 ATMs / 531 POS. FBA also publishes the H1-2026 PRELIMINARY table (pub. 13/08/2026): FBiH-HQ banks 1,400 ATMs / 28,834 POS at 30/06/2026 (provisional).
signals.source_name: FBA — Informacija o subjektima bankarskog sistema FBiH, 31.12.2025 (konačni podaci)
signals.implies: An authoritative, bank-by-bank ATM estate makes NCR Atleos hardware refresh, x-core multivendor ATM software and telemetry/managed-service bids addressable per bank.
signals.likelihood: High — estate is published and growing
signals.followup: Get the FINAL Q2-2026 FBA Informacija when published (~Oct-2026) to firm the provisional 1,400/28,834.

signals.signal: RS half of the estate, from ABRS Table 4 / KTabeleBanke.xlsx: banks HQ'd in Republika Srpska had 478 ATMs and 10,168 POS at 31/12/2025 (end-2024: 440 / 8,231) = +38 ATMs and +1,937 POS y/y; FBiH-HQ banks' RS units add 144 ATMs / 4,635 POS. The 30/06/2026 file (posted Aug-2026) shows RS-HQ banks at 490 ATMs / 12,483 POS (provisional). Adding the two regulators' HQ-based, mutually exclusive figures gives a BiH-wide estate of 1,863 ATMs / 38,269 POS at end-2025 and 1,890 ATMs / 41,317 POS at 30/06/2026 — this SUM is arithmetic on two primary figures, NOT a published BiH total; CBBiH publishes no device count.
signals.source_name: ABRS — Izvještaj o stanju u bankarskom sistemu RS 01.01.-31.12.2025 + 20260630KTabeleBanke.xlsx
signals.implies: POS growing ~+24% y/y in RS vs ~+4% in FBiH: strongest lane is Verifone/Castles terminals + TMS and softPOS/tap-to-phone for RS acquirers.
signals.followup: Confirm whether ABRS row I covers RS-HQ banks' whole-BiH estate (report text implies yes: 3 RS banks have 33 units in FBiH).

signals.signal: CONFIRMS the previously UNCONFIRMED estate AND gives the recycler split. CBBiH annual report 'Kartičarstvo u BiH u 2025. godini' (ref. period FY-2025, pub. 11/03/2026), section 12: 1,868 ATMs installed in BiH at end-2025 (2024: 1,767; 2023: 1,717; 2022: 1,653; 2021: 1,628) and 37,895 POS (2024: 35,035), of which 37,647 in merchants and 248 at bank counters. Critically, the ATM split is 1,281 dispense-only + 567 deposit-AND-dispense ('uplatno-isplatni' = cash-accepting/recycling ATMs) + 20 bill-payment. Deposit-capable ATMs jumped from 345 to 567 (+64.3% y/y) while dispense-only ATMs FELL from 1,294 to 1,281 — the estate is not growing, it is converting.
signals.source_name: CBBiH — Kartičarstvo u BiH u 2025. godini
signals.implies: A hard, named replacement cycle for cash recyclers (an ATM that re-dispenses notes customers deposited, cutting cash-in-transit runs): +222 deposit-capable units in one year. Direct fit for NCR intelligent-deposit/recycling ATMs, Glory/Sesami TCRs, APTRA OptiCash cash optimisation and IBNS/anti-skimming retrofits.
signals.likelihood: High — conversion already running at +222 units/yr
signals.followup: Ask each of the 13 FBiH + 8 RS banks which deposit ATMs are true recyclers vs deposit-only; target the 1,281 remaining dispense-only units.

signals.entity: CBBiH — IPS BiH instant payment system
signals.signal: IPS BiH participant list has GROWN from 3 to 5 banks since the 20/07/2026 go-live. The CBBiH IPS BiH page now shows five live banks: Intesa Sanpaolo Banka BiH, Raiffeisen Bank BiH, Sparkasse Bank BiH plus TWO NEW joiners — Nova Banka a.d. Banja Luka and ATOS Bank a.d. Banja Luka (both Republika Srpska-HQ). Scheme rules: 24/7/365, max 5,000 KM per transaction, domestic interbank only in phase 1, built on the Banca d'Italia TIPS Clone. CBBiH's monthly 'Statistika ŽK i BPRV' (July-2026 edition) still reports ONLY RTGS + giro-clearing, so NO official IPS volume series exists yet.
signals.source_name: CBBiH — Instant platni sistemi - IPS BiH
signals.implies: 17 of 22 BiH banks still have to build ISO 20022 instant-payment connectivity, 24/7 liquidity monitoring and real-time fraud screening — INETCO transaction monitoring, x-core/channel adaptation and HSM/PCI-PIN work.
signals.likelihood: High — CBBiH says system open to all banks
signals.followup: Approach the 17 non-live banks; ask CBBiH when IPS volumes join the monthly statistics release.

signals.signal: Cash outside banks reached 7.46bn KM at 31/12/2025, +8.56% y/y (CBBiH Annual Report 2025, pub. 09/04/2026); total banknotes and coins in circulation on the CBBiH balance sheet 8,538,481 thousand KM at 31/12/2025. CBBiH destroyed 17.09 million unfit banknotes in 2025. At the same time the CASH SHARE of card turnover fell to 65% (from 68% in 2024) and ATM withdrawals were 13.59bn KM of a 21.10bn KM card total (64% of value). Card transactions 215,077,126 in 2025 (2024: 186,045,013), average 98 KM; 70% of card transactions contactless.
signals.implies: Cash volume rising while cash SHARE falls = the classic recycler business case: banks must handle more physical notes across a flat branch network. NCR APTRA OptiCash + Glory/Sesami TCR + CIT-route optimisation.
signals.followup: Get the 2026 half-year cash figure from the CBBiH Quarterly Bulletin.

signals.signal: Branch network is FLAT, digital is not. CBBiH 'Platni sistemi u BiH u 2025' (pub. 30/03/2026): total bank organisational units 749 at end-2025, identical to 749 in 2024 (2023: 747; 2022: 761; 2021: 723; 2020: 789) — FBiH 450 / RS 283 / Brcko 16. Meanwhile e-banking subscribers hit 2,013,444 (2024: 1,770,172, +13.7%), of which 149,651 legal entities; active mobile-banking clients 696,638; 49.29 million e-banking transactions worth 179.69bn KM in 2025. Bill PAYMENT via ATM is effectively nil: 4,990 transactions by individuals and ZERO by companies in the whole of 2025.
signals.source_name: CBBiH — Platni sistemi u BiH u 2025. godini
signals.implies: Frozen branch count + surging digital = branch-transformation and self-service kiosk lane. The near-zero ATM bill-payment number is a whitespace: BiH ATMs are cash-dispensers only, no payment/kiosk functionality — a direct kiosk + x-core application opportunity.
signals.followup: Pitch kiosk/bill-payment functionality on existing estates; quantify per-branch teller cost with the 749-unit base.
